name: The Holy Land
overview: The Holy Land holds profound significance as the divinely promised inheritance to Abraham and his descendants, established through God's covenant granting the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates (Genesis 15:18; 28:13). Scripture affirms God's sovereign ownership of the land, reminding His people that they are but strangers and sojourners under His authority (Leviticus 25:23). This sacred geography is inseparably linked to the unfolding of God's redemptive plan, culminating in the love of God demonstrated through the gift of His Son, who offers eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16). Believers are called to love the Lord with all their heart, soul, and might, recognizing that their relationship with God is central within this holy context (Deuteronomy 6:5).
